title: Update Deal Request
description: Request parameters for updating a deal. Uses PATCH semantics — only send fields to change. Mutable fields: pricing (floor/fixed price), curator fee, flight dates, pause/resume status. Immutable fields (deal_type, buyer seats, platform) cannot be changed after creation.

pricing.description: Updated pricing. For curated/PMP deals, floor_price can be adjusted mid-flight without buyer re-acceptance. For PG deals, price changes may require buyer re-acceptance on some DSPs.

start_time.description: Updated campaign start date/time in ISO 8601 format

end_time.description: Updated campaign end date/time in ISO 8601 format

paused.description: Pause (true) or resume (false) the deal. A paused deal stops receiving bid requests on the SSP.

push_notification_config.description: Optional webhook configuration for async update status notifications.
